OpenRun console - todo flow walkthrough

Generated by TestTodoE2EFlow on 2026-08-25 17:37: overview → postgres service (secret url) → /bind/todo binding → /todo1 app (validate, then create) → console pages → overview. Each step is a light/dark screenshot pair; this page picks per your OS theme (`prefers-color-scheme`). 15 steps.

0101-overview

Overview home page: system status at a glance before the flow - apps, syncs, containers, services and recent activity.

0202-service-form

New service form: id postgres/tododb, the connection url locked into the secrets store ({{secret ...}} reference in the value field).

0303-bindings-service

Service created: postgres/tododb listed with its config key (the url value stays server-side).

0404-binding-form

New binding form: /bind/todo sourced from the postgres/tododb service. Creating it provisions an account on the database.

0505-bindings-populated

Bindings page with the service and the /bind/todo base binding.

0606-app-create-form

New app form: /todo1 from the github todo example, spec python-fasthtml, APP_MODULE=admin:app and the /bind/todo binding picked from the dropdown.

0707-app-validated

Validate (dry run): the source was fetched and checked, the permissions the app will request are listed for review.

0808-apps-list

Apps page with /todo1 created. No approval step was needed: the spec's permissions and the default postgres service's binding source are pre-allowed by the default server config.

0909-app-detail

App detail for /todo1: versions, requested permissions and the open-app links.

1010-containers

Containers page: the todo app's container is up.

1111-audit

Audit page: the create/approve operations recorded during this flow.

1212-syncs

Syncs page (declarative sources seeded by the suite).

1313-builder

App builder page.

1414-config

Configuration page.

1515-overview-final

Back on the Overview home page: the todo app shows in the apps tile's spec breakdown and its running container is counted in the containers tile.
